categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of active phased array radar systems, primarily focusing on X-band dual-polarization active phased array weather radars and related software and hardware products. Its products are mainly applied in meteorological detection and hydrological rainfall measurement, with expanding applications in civil aviation, marine monitoring, low-altitude economy, and public safety sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including full-polarization active phased array radar integrating phased array and polarization technologies, dual-polarization microstrip array antenna technology, full-solid-state dual-polarization transceiver units, modular power synthesis and distribution networks, and a proprietary all-FPGA high-speed radar signal processing platform. Production involves in-house R&D, assembly, testing, and software integration, with some outsourced processes like PCB assembly and component processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government departments and public institutions involved in meteorology, water conservancy, civil aviation, marine monitoring, and public safety. The company serves markets in weather radar systems, hydrological rainfall measurement, air traffic control, low-altitude economic activities, and emergency response sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with radar systems deployed across 23 provinces, municipalities, autonomous regions, and Hong Kong SAR. It has begun market expansion efforts into Hong Kong and overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the radar industry supply chain, focusing on system integration, manufacturing of radar equipment, software development, and providing radar detection solutions and services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes innovation in full-polarization active phased array radar technology, expanding product lines to include C-band, S-band, Ku-band radars, and portable anti-drone radar systems. R&D priorities include enhancing hardware performance, software capabilities for diverse applications, and extending into related fields such as millimeter-wave radar and radar chip design. The company invests heavily in R&D, with ongoing projects targeting advanced weather radar systems and multi-functional radar applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of radar equipment and systems, supplemented by software and algorithm service offerings. Sales are conducted mainly via bidding and commercial negotiations, with revenue recognized upon product delivery, installation, and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is recognized as a leading domestic enterprise in full-polarization active phased array radar technology, with international advanced-level products. It holds a competitive position in meteorological and hydrological radar markets, with awards and recognition for technological innovation. Competitors include established domestic and international radar manufacturers, especially those with military and civil applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 345 million, a 62.49% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 76.6 million, up 21.03%. Total assets reached RMB 2.5 billion, with steady growth in net assets. The company maintains a robust growth trajectory supported by increased sales in core radar product lines and expanding market applications.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary full-polarization active phased array radar technology that offers high spatial and temporal resolution, multi-functionality, and high reliability with modular design. Its products provide superior detection capabilities for rapidly evolving and severe weather phenomena, low-altitude targets, and multi-target tracking. The integration of hardware and software solutions, cost-effective manufacturing using mature PCB processes, and a comprehensive radar data processing platform enhance customer value and competitive advantage.
